**Status:** Provisional analytic solution to frozen free resolvent exponent.
**Machine registry:** candidate (unchanged). **Audit type:** individual mathematical scoping review, not independent peer review or a Lean-checked new result.

**Model freeze.** On $L^2(\mathbb R^2)$, $H_0=(\Delta+1)^2$ with domain $H^4$. Fix $w(x)=\langle x\rangle^{-3}$, $0<\kappa<1$, $R_\kappa=(H_0+\kappa)^{-1}$, $N(\kappa)=\|wR_\kappa w\|_{L^2\to L^2}$.
